agendas.title: People
agendas.description: Improve supply and health so the population can grow without hunger.

agendas.description: Reduce stoppages, build a reliable surplus and keep works maintained.

agendas.title: Planetary coordination
agendas.description: Space industry, long-range resources and the whole world as one system.
